organicPestControlSteps.title: Keep Your Environment Clean and Sealed
organicPestControlSteps.description: Regularly clean up areas that attract pests, like kitchens, corners, and outdoor spaces. Seal cracks and gaps in doors, windows, and walls to prevent pests from entering.

organicPestControlSteps.title: Introduce Natural Predators
organicPestControlSteps.description: Encourage or introduce beneficial insects like ladybugs or birds to control pests naturally. They help keep pest populations down without harming the environment.

organicPestControlSteps.title: Use Organic Sprays and Natural Deterrents
organicPestControlSteps.description: Use natural options like neem oil, garlic spray, or a mild soap solution. These can be sprayed directly on pests or on plants to prevent infestations.

organicPestControlSteps.title: Regular Monitoring and Maintenance
organicPestControlSteps.description: Frequently check for signs of pests so you can address them early. Simple, consistent maintenance like removing debris and keeping plants healthy can prevent infestations.

organicPestControl.title: Neem Oil Spray
organicPestControl.description: Derived from neem tree seeds, neem oil is effective against a wide range of garden pests, including aphids, mites, and whiteflies. It interferes with pest hormone systems, preventing them from maturing and reproducing.

organicPestControl.title: Insecticidal Soap
organicPestControl.description: Made from plant-based fatty acids, insecticidal soap works by breaking down the outer layers of soft-bodied insects, such as aphids, spider mites, and mealybugs. Safe for most plants, effective for indoor and outdoor use.

organicPestControl.title: Diatomaceous Earth
organicPestControl.description: A fine powder made from fossilized algae, it dehydrates pests like ants, fleas, and slugs. Safe to sprinkle in gardens or around the house.

organicPestControl.title: Garlic Barrier Spray
organicPestControl.description: A natural garlic-based spray that repels pests like mosquitoes, aphids, and beetles. Its smell fades quickly for humans but deters pests for several weeks.
